MPSGraphDevice.doc: A class that describes the compute device.

MPSGraphExecutable.doc: The compiled representation of a compute graph executable.

MPSGraphExecutableExecutionDescriptor.doc: A class that consists of all the levers to synchronize and schedule executable execution.

MPSGraphExecutionDescriptor.doc: A class that consists of all the levers to synchronize and schedule graph execution.

MPSGraphFFTDescriptor.doc: The class that defines the parameters for a fast Fourier transform (FFT) operation.

MPSGraphGRUDescriptor.doc: The class that defines the parameters for a gated recurrent unit (GRU) operation.

MPSGraphImToColOpDescriptor.doc: The class that defines the parameters for an image to column or column to image operation.

MPSGraphLSTMDescriptor.doc: The class that defines the parameters for a long short-term memory (LSTM) operation.

MPSGraphObject.doc: The common base class for all Metal Performance Shaders Graph objects.

MPSGraphOperation.doc: A symbolic representation of a compute operation.

MPSGraphPooling2DOpDescriptor.doc: The class that defines the parameters for a 2D pooling operation.

MPSGraphPooling4DOpDescriptor.doc: The class that defines the parameters for a 4D pooling operation.

MPSGraphRandomOpDescriptor.doc: A class that describes the random operation.

MPSGraphShapedType.doc: The shaped type class for types on tensors with a shape and data type.

MPSGraphSingleGateRNNDescriptor.doc: The class that defines the parameters for a single gate RNN operation.

MPSGraphStencilOpDescriptor.doc: The class that defines the parameters for a stencil operation.

MPSGraphTensor.doc: The symbolic representation of a compute data type.

MPSGraphTensorData.doc: The representation of a compute data type.

MPSGraphType.doc: The base type class for types on tensors.

MPSGraphVariableOp.doc: The class that defines the parameters for a variable.

MPSGraphDeploymentPlatform.doc: The options available to a graph.

MPSGraphExecutionStage.doc: Execution events that can be used with shared events.

MPSGraphExecutionStageCompleted.doc: stage when execution of the graph completes.

MPSGraphFFTScalingMode.doc: The scaling modes for Fourier transform operations.

MPSGraphFFTScalingModeNone.doc: Computes the FFT result with no scaling.

MPSGraphFFTScalingModeSize.doc: Scales the FFT result with reciprocal of the total FFT size over all transformed dimensions.

MPSGraphFFTScalingModeUnitary.doc: Scales the FFT result with reciprocal square root of the total FFT size over all transformed dimensions, resulting in signal strength conserving transformation.

MPSGraphLossReductionType.doc: The type of the reduction the graph applies in the loss operations.

MPSGraphLossReductionTypeMean.doc: Reduces the loss down to a scalar with a mean operation.

MPSGraphLossReductionTypeSum.doc: Reduces the loss down to a scalar with a sum operation.

MPSGraphOptimization.doc: The optimization levels to trade compilation time for even more runtime performance by running more passes.

MPSGraphOptimizationLevel1.doc: Graph performs additional Optimizations, like using the placement pass to dispatch across different HW blocks like the NeuralEngine and CPU along with the GPU.

MPSGraphOptimizationProfile.doc: The optimization profile used as a heuristic as the graph compiler optimizes the network.

MPSGraphOptions.doc: The options available to a graph.

MPSGraphOptionsDefault.doc: The framework uses these options as default if not overriden.

MPSGraphOptionsSynchronizeResults.doc: The graph synchronizes results to the CPU using a blit encoder if on a discrete GPU at the end of execution.

MPSGraphOptionsVerbose.doc: The framework prints more logging info.

MPSGraphPaddingModePeriodic.doc: Periodic x[-2] -> x[L-3], where L is size of x.

MPSGraphPoolingReturnIndicesMode.doc: The flattening mode for returned indices with max-pooling.

MPSGraphPoolingReturnIndicesGlobalFlatte.doc: Returns indices flattened in inner most (last) dimension.
Returns indices flattened in 2 innermost dimensions. eg: HW in NCHW.
Returns indices flattened in 3 innernost dimensions. eg: HWC in NHWC.
Returns indices flattened in 4 innermost dimensions.

MPSGraphPoolingReturnIndicesLocalFlatten.doc: Returns indices within pooling window, flattened in inner most dimension.
Returns indices within pooling window, flattened in 2 innermost dimensions. eg: HW in NCHW.
Returns indices within pooling window, flattened in 3 innernost dimensions. eg: HWC in NHWC.
Returns indices within pooling window, flattened in 4 innermost dimensions.

MPSGraphRNNActivation.doc: The activation modes for RNN operations.

MPSGraphRandomDistribution.doc: The distributions supported by random operations.

MPSGraphRandomDistributionNormal.doc: The normal distribution defined by mean and standard deviation.

MPSGraphRandomDistributionTruncatedNorma.doc: The normal distribution defined by mean and standard deviation, truncated to the range [min, max)

MPSGraphRandomDistributionUniform.doc: The uniform distribution, with samples drawn uniformly from [min, max) for float types, and [min, max] for integer types.

MPSGraphRandomNormalSamplingMethod.doc: The sampling method to use when generating values in the normal distribution.

MPSGraphRandomNormalSamplingBoxMuller.doc: Use Box Muller transform to convert uniform values to values in the normal distribution. For bounded distributions this is a rejection sampling method.

MPSGraphRandomNormalSamplingInvCDF.doc: Use inverse erf to convert uniform values to values in the normal distribution

MPSGraphReducedPrecisionFastMath.doc: MPSGraph could use these reduced precision paths to deliver faster math, but it is not guaranteed.

MPSGraphReducedPrecisionFastMathAllowCon.doc: Allow conversion of operands to FP19 or TF32 from FP32 when needed by dropping 13 mantissa bits.

MPSGraphReducedPrecisionFastMathAllowFP1.doc: Execute winograd transform intermediate as FP16.
Curated list allowing intermediates for multi-pass GPU kernels to be FP16.

MPSGraphReducedPrecisionFastMathNone.doc: Full precision math with maximum accuracy.

MPSGraphResizeMode.doc: The resize mode to use for resizing.

MPSGraphResizeBilinear.doc: Samples the 4 neighbors to the pixel coordinate and uses bilinear interpolation.

MPSGraphResizeNearest.doc: Samples the nearest neighbor to the pixel coordinate.

MPSGraphResizeNearestRoundingMode.doc: The rounding mode to use when using nearest resize mode.

MPSGraphResizeNearestRoundingModeRoundPr.doc: Rounds values to the nearest integer value, with 0.5f offset rounding toward +inf.
Rounds values to the nearest integer value, with 0.5f rounding toward -inf.

MPSGraphResizeNearestRoundingModeRoundTo.doc: Rounds values to the nearest integer value, with 0.5f rounding toward the closest even value.
Rounds values to the nearest integer value, with 0.5f rounding toward the closest odd value.

MPSGraphSparseStorageType.doc: The sparse storage options in the Metal Performance Shaders Graph framework.

dilationRateInX.doc: Defines the dilation rate for the width dimension.

dilationRateInY.doc: Defines the dilation rate for the height dimension.

includeZeroPadToAverage.doc: Defines a mode for average pooling, where samples outside the input tensor count as zeroes in the average computation.

kernelHeight.doc: Defines the pooling window size for the height dimension.

kernelWidth.doc: Defines the pooling window size for the width dimension.

paddingBottom.doc: Defines the explicit padding value for the height dimension to add after the data.

paddingLeft.doc: Defines the explicit padding value for the width dimension to add before the data.

paddingRight.doc: Defines the explicit padding value for the width dimension to add after the data.

paddingStyle.doc: Defines what kind of padding graph applies to the operation.

paddingTop.doc: Defines the explicit padding value for the height dimension to add before the data.

returnIndicesDataType.doc: Defines the data type for returned indices. Use this in conjunction with maxPooling2DReturnIndicesWithSourceTensor:descriptor:name: API. Currently MPSGraph supports the following datatypes: MPSDataTypeInt32. Default value: MPSDataTypeInt32.

returnIndicesMode.doc: Defines the mode for returned indices of maximum values within each pooling window. Use this in conjunction with maxPooling2DReturnIndicesWithSourceTensor:descriptor:name: API. If returnIndicesMode = MPSGraphPoolingReturnIndicesNone then only the first result MPSGraph returns from maxPooling2DReturnIndicesWithSourceTensor:descriptor:name: will be valid and using the second result will assert. Default value: MPSGraphPoolingReturnIndicesNone.

strideInX.doc: Defines the stride for the width dimension.

strideInY.doc: Defines the stride for the height dimension.

ceilMode.doc: Affects how MPSGraph computes the output size: if set to YES then output size is computed by rounding up instead of down when dividing input size by stride.

dilationRates.doc: Defines dilation rates for spatial dimensions. Must be four numbers, one for each spatial dimension, fastest running index last.

includeZeroPadToAverage.doc: Defines a mode for average pooling, where samples outside the input tensor count as zeroes in the average computation.

paddingStyle.doc: Defines what kind of padding graph applies to the operation.

paddingValues.doc: Defines padding values for spatial dimensions which must be eight numbers, two for each spatial dimension.

returnIndicesDataType.doc: Defines the data type for returned indices.

returnIndicesMode.doc: Defines the mode for returned indices of maximum values within each pooling window.

strides.doc: Defines strides for spatial dimensions. Must be four numbers, one for each spatial dimension, fastest running index last.

dataType.doc: The data type of the generated result values.

distribution.doc: The type of distribution to draw samples from. See MPSGraphRandomDistribution.

max.doc: The upper range of the distribution.

maxInteger.doc: The upper range of the distribution.

min.doc: The lower range of the distribution.

minInteger.doc: The lower range of the distribution.

samplingMethod.doc: The sampling method of the distribution.

standardDeviation.doc: The standard deviation of the distribution.

dataType.doc: The data type of the shaped type.

shape.doc: The Shape of the shaped type.

activation.doc: A parameter that defines the activation function to use with the RNN operation.

bidirectional.doc: A parameter that defines a bidirectional RNN layer.

reverse.doc: A parameter that defines time direction of the input sequence.

training.doc: A parameter that makes the RNN layer support training.

boundaryMode.doc: The property that determines which values to use for padding the input tensor.

dilationRates.doc: The property that defines dilation rates for spatial dimensions.

explicitPadding.doc: The property that defines padding values for spatial dimensions.

offsets.doc: An array of length four that determines from which offset to start reading the input tensor.

paddingConstant.doc: The padding value for boundaryMode = MPSGraphPaddingModeConstant.

paddingStyle.doc: The property that defines what kind of padding to apply to the stencil operation.

reductionMode.doc: The reduction mode to use within the stencil window.

strides.doc: The property that defines strides for spatial dimensions.

dataType.doc: The data type of the tensor.

operation.doc: The operation responsible for creating this tensor.

dataType.doc: The data type of the tensor data.

device.doc: The device of the tensor data.

shape.doc: The shape of the tensor data.

dataType.doc: The data type of the variable.
